cc:Work.dc:title: figure2_information_characterization
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 2. Information characterization. (a) The registered matched B-family spatial field reduces equal-domain CAI-ratio MAE relative to its scalar counterpart, and the selected sparse condition retains 89.9% of the registered full-field gain while remaining distinct from the full field. (b) Exact-cost oracle comparisons show heterogeneous, task-conditioned spatial value. (c) Teacher priorities change with accumulated evidence. (d) Value-rank agreement depends on the downstream predictor. Oracle and teacher rows are retrospective.
